TOPICS.Definition: subjects that people talk or write about

CRYPTIDS.Definition: creatures that some people believe in but science has never shown to be real

STOOD OUT.Definition: seemed more noticeable or interesting than the others

OUTLINE.Definition: a basic plan showing the main points

ENCOURAGING.Definition: positive and giving hope that things would go well

OUT LOUD.Definition: using the voice, so that people can hear it

TRIVIA.Definition: small, unusual facts that are interesting but not important

COMPELLING.Definition: very interesting and hard to stop listening to

NARRATIVE.Definition: a story or account of events

ON THIS COUNT.Definition: in this respect; on this point

SECTION.Definition: a separate part of the script

INCONSISTENCIES.Definition: details that did not fit together or match the facts

SCRIPTWRITERS.Definition: people whose job is to produce the words spoken in shows, films or podcasts

ARCHIVES.Definition: stored collections of old records and documents

THOUGHT EXPERIMENT.Definition: an exercise in which you imagine a situation to explore an idea

HEART-BREAKING.Definition: very sad; causing great emotional pain

ETHICAL.Definition: morally right and fair to people

HANDMADE.Definition: produced by people, not by machines

INTRICATE.Definition: very detailed, with many small parts or steps

FLOOD.Definition: a very large number that appear at the same time

PROMPTS.Definition: instructions or questions typed in to tell the AI what to produce

CLICHE.Definition: a phrase that has been used so often that it is no longer original

GAME CHANGER.Definition: something that completely changes the way things are done

GENERIC.Definition: ordinary and not special or original

SCORED.Definition: got a goal or point in the game

THE PRESERVE OF.Definition: something that only belongs to or is done by

COLUMNIST.Definition: a journalist who regularly writes an opinion article for a newspaper or magazine
